import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { languages } from "./languages";
import { users } from "./users";
import { diaryComments } from "./diary_comments";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "title" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "created_at" is timestamp without time zone, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
//   - "updated_at" is timestamp without time zone, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
//   - "language_code" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - the many-to-many with users through diary_entry_subscriptions is declared on users only: declaring it here too would re-key diary_entry_subscriptions from (user_id, diary_entry_id).
export const diaryEntries = defineTable("diary_entries", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial().primaryKey(),
        userId: col.bigint().notNull(),
        title: col.text().notNull(),
        body: col.text().notNull(),
        createdAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone").notNull(),
        updatedAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone").notNull(),
        latitude: col.doublePrecision(),
        longitude: col.doublePrecision(),
        languageCode: col.text().notNull().default("en"),
        visible: col.boolean().notNull().default(true),
        bodyFormat: col.enum(["html", "markdown", "text"], { name: "format_enum" }).notNull().default("markdown")
    },
    relations: {
        languageCodeRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => languages, { localKey: "language_code", onDelete: "no action" }),
        user: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        diary_comments: rel.hasMany(() => diaryComments)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
